name: seo-toolkit
description: End-to-end SEO + AI-search discoverability stack for any production website. Walks through Google Search Console verification, sitemap submission, Bing Webmaster Tools import, IndexNow setup with auto-ping CI, Google Analytics 4 wiring, Google Business Profile setup, share-preview metadata polish, and the dynamic-OG fallback pattern. Battle-tested on real deploys — includes the gotchas (WOFF2 vs TTF, cross-OS file writes, PowerShell brackets) that bit us in production.
